title: CampScrap catalog
description: Lets the workshop scrap world objects that have no FO4 scrap recipe of their own.
x-help:
FO4 scraps a world object only when a scrap recipe (a COBJ filtered by WorkshopRecipeFilterScrap) creates its base form. Each row here gives a base form such a recipe: in workshop mode the object can then be scrapped for that recipe's components, and, like FO4's cars and junk piles, it can no longer be moved or stored.

Objects that already have a recipe (anything buildable, or scrappable through a vanilla list) keep their own.
